summary.name: Marvel
summary.one_liner: Marvel is an online design and prototyping platform for wireframing, designing, prototyping, generating design specs, and handing off work to development.
use_cases: wireframing a new app or website
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Marvel as a tool for wireframing, designing and prototyping, from low to high fidelity. It says the product can instantly generate design specs for handoff and connect with integrations to fit into existing workflows. It states that customers include large companies, startups and schools who use it to ideate, collaborate and refine prototypes before development. The page text does not describe specific features in detail beyond these points.
notable: Generates design specs instantly for developer handoff
Supports low to high-fidelity wireframes and prototypes
caveats: Listed as Freeware on awesome-mac, but the page text itself does not state pricing details
Platform details beyond the web-based design platform are not stated on the page
